summary: Will validity under s.63(c) Indian Succession Act; interpretation standard: liberal vs strict; spacing irregularity in concluding portion not invalidating; attestation requirement: personal acknowledgment suffices; High Court error in demanding attestation witness testimony about direction for signature; Civil Court set aside, appellate Court restored; Will execution standard proof preponderance not beyond reasonable doubt.
legal_provisions_cited: Pankajakshi (Dead) through LRs v. Chandrika and Ors.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; Lower Appellate Court decision restored; Will held valid.
